reviews.comment:
Sigue siendo una tradición por ser del ACA falta modernizar sirven café c/leche en taza sin plato. Muchos empleados mal asignadas las funciones el mismo empleado que hace el. Café y después cobra habiendo otros empleados sin hacer nada.

(Translated by Google)
It's still a tradition at the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina), but they need to modernize. They serve coffee with milk in cups without saucers. Many employees have poorly assigned duties; the same employee makes the coffee and then gets paid, while other employees do nothing.
